params.fix_hint: Send a system user access token, and keep it server-side.

params.name: test_event_code
params.description: It routes events to the Events Manager test tool instead of production reporting, so it should not appear on live traffic.
params.fix_hint: Drop `test_event_code` outside of testing.

params.name: data
params.description: The cited primary model documents this field representation.

rules.message: A query parameter carries what looks like a raw email address. Conversions API customer information must be normalized and SHA-256 hashed.
rules.fix_hint: Hash the value with SHA-256 and send it in the event payload rather than on the URL.

params.name: data
params.description: The vendor documents the JSON shape or value type of this field.

params.name: data[]
params.description: The vendor documents the JSON shape or value type of this field.

params.name: event_name
params.description: It is the standard or custom event name, and it has to match the browser event for deduplication to work.
params.fix_hint: Set `event_name` to the standard event, such as `Purchase`, or to your custom event name.

params.name: event_time
params.description: Meta documents it as a Unix timestamp in seconds, and it can be up to 7 days before the event is sent. A 13-digit value is milliseconds and lands far in the future.
params.fix_hint: Send seconds, not milliseconds: divide a JavaScript `Date.now()` by 1000 and floor it.

params.name: action_source
params.description: It tells Meta where the conversion happened, and Meta accepts a fixed set of values.
params.fix_hint: Use one of the documented values; website conversions are `website`.

params.name: user_data
params.description: Customer information is required on every server event, and it is what Meta matches the conversion to a person with.
params.fix_hint: Add a `user_data` object with at least one normalized, hashed identifier.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Meta recommends it for deduplication: the browser pixel and the server event have to carry the same `event_id` and `event_name` to be counted once.
params.fix_hint: Generate one id per conversion and send the same value from the pixel and the Conversions API.

params.name: event_source_url
params.description: It is the page URL where the conversion happened, and Meta requires it for website events.
params.fix_hint: Send the full URL of the page, including the scheme.

params.name: opt_out
params.description: When true, the event is used for attribution only and not for ads delivery optimization.

params.name: data_processing_options[]
params.description: Meta accepts `LDU` for Limited Data Use, or an empty array.
params.fix_hint: Send `["LDU"]` to enable Limited Data Use, or `[]` to leave it off.

params.name: data_processing_options_country
params.description: It is 1 for the United States, or 0 to let Meta geolocate.

params.name: data_processing_options_state
params.description: It is 1000 for California, or 0 to let Meta geolocate.

params.name: custom_data.value
params.description: Meta requires it for purchase events and for any event that uses value optimization.
params.fix_hint: Send the monetary value as a number, without a currency symbol.

params.name: custom_data.currency
params.description: Meta requires a valid ISO 4217 three-digit currency code.
params.fix_hint: Use the three-letter code, such as `USD`.

params.name: custom_data.content_ids[]
params.description: It is a product ID associated with the event, such as a SKU on AddToCart.
params.fix_hint: Send catalog IDs in `custom_data.content_ids`, or drop empty entries.

params.name: custom_data.content_type
params.description: It says whether `content_ids` and `contents` are products or product groups. Meta documents `product` or `product_group`.
params.fix_hint: Set `custom_data.content_type` to `product` or `product_group`.

params.name: custom_data.contents[].id
params.description: It is the product ID on a contents row. Meta documents `id`, `quantity`, `item_price`, and `delivery_category` on that object.
params.fix_hint: Set `custom_data.contents[].id` to the catalog item ID, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: custom_data.contents[].quantity
params.description: It is how many of that product the event covers.
params.fix_hint: Send a whole number in `custom_data.contents[].quantity`, such as `1`.

params.name: custom_data.contents[].item_price
params.description: It is the price of that product. Put the order total in `custom_data.value`.
params.fix_hint: Send `custom_data.contents[].item_price` as a number, such as `129.99`, without a currency symbol.

params.name: custom_data.contents[].delivery_category
params.description: It is the delivery type on a contents row. Meta documents `in_store`, `curbside`, and `home_delivery`.
params.fix_hint: Set the contents `delivery_category` to `in_store`, `curbside`, or `home_delivery`.

params.name: custom_data.delivery_category
params.description: It is the delivery type for a purchase event. Meta documents `in_store`, `curbside`, and `home_delivery`.
params.fix_hint: Set `custom_data.delivery_category` to `in_store`, `curbside`, or `home_delivery`.

params.name: custom_data.num_items
params.description: It is the number of items in checkout. Meta documents it for InitiateCheckout events.
params.fix_hint: Send a whole number in `custom_data.num_items`, such as `2`.

params.name: custom_data.order_id
params.description: It is the order ID for this transaction, as a string.
params.fix_hint: Send `custom_data.order_id`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: custom_data.search_string
params.description: It is the query the user searched for. Meta documents it for Search events.
params.fix_hint: Send the query in `custom_data.search_string`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: custom_data.predicted_ltv
params.description: It is the predicted lifetime value of a conversion event.
params.fix_hint: Send `custom_data.predicted_ltv` as a number, such as `250.00`.

params.name: referrer_url
params.description: It is the referrer URL for the event.
params.fix_hint: Send an absolute URL in `referrer_url`, including the scheme.

params.name: user_data.em
params.description: Email must be trimmed, lowercased, and SHA-256 hashed before it is sent.
params.fix_hint: Normalize the address, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

params.name: user_data.em[]
params.description: Every email in the list must be normalized and SHA-256 hashed.
params.fix_hint: Normalize each address, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digests.

params.name: user_data.ph
params.description: Phone numbers must have symbols and letters removed, carry the country code, and be SHA-256 hashed.
params.fix_hint: Normalize the number to digits with the country code, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

params.name: user_data.ph[]
params.description: Every phone number in the list must be normalized and SHA-256 hashed.
params.fix_hint: Normalize each number to digits with the country code and hash it with SHA-256.

params.name: user_data.fn
params.description: First name must be lowercased and SHA-256 hashed.

params.name: user_data.ln
params.description: Last name must be lowercased and SHA-256 hashed.

params.name: user_data.ge
params.description: Gender is sent as a lowercase initial and SHA-256 hashed.

params.name: user_data.db
params.description: Date of birth is normalized to YYYYMMDD and SHA-256 hashed.

params.name: user_data.ct
params.description: City is lowercased with punctuation and spaces removed, then SHA-256 hashed.

params.name: user_data.st
params.description: State is the lowercase two-character code, SHA-256 hashed.

params.name: user_data.zp
params.description: Zip is lowercased without spaces or dashes, then SHA-256 hashed.

params.name: user_data.country
params.description: Country is the lowercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, SHA-256 hashed.
params.fix_hint: Hash the two-letter code rather than sending it in the clear.

params.name: user_data.external_id
params.description: Meta recommends hashing the advertiser's own identifier with SHA-256.

params.name: user_data.client_ip_address
params.description: It is sent unhashed, and it must be the real IPv4 or IPv6 address of the browser.
params.fix_hint: Send the client address as-is; do not hash it and do not send your server's address.

params.name: user_data.client_user_agent
params.description: It is sent unhashed, and it must be the browser's user agent rather than your HTTP client's.
params.fix_hint: Forward the browser `User-Agent` header from the original request.

params.name: user_data.fbc
params.description: Meta documents the click id cookie as `fb.${subdomain_index}.${creation_time}.${fbclid}`.
params.fix_hint: Send the `_fbc` cookie verbatim, or rebuild it in the documented format.

params.name: user_data.fbp
params.description: Meta documents the browser id cookie as `fb.${subdomain_index}.${creation_time}.${random_number}`.
params.fix_hint: Send the `_fbp` cookie verbatim.

params.name: user_data.lead_id
params.description: It is the numeric id Meta generated for a Lead Ads lead.

rules.fix_hint: Add `custom_data.value` as a number and `custom_data.currency` as an ISO 4217 code.

rules.message: The event is marked `action_source: website` but carries no `event_source_url`, which Meta requires for website events.
rules.fix_hint: Send the page URL the conversion happened on.

rules.message: Limited Data Use is enabled but `data_processing_options_country` is missing.
rules.fix_hint: Send `data_processing_options_country` as 1 for the United States, or 0 to let Meta geolocate.

rules.message: A field carries what looks like a raw email address. Meta requires customer information to be normalized and SHA-256 hashed before it is sent.
rules.fix_hint: Trim the address, lowercase it, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

rules.message: This field looks like a SHA-256 digest, but Meta documents it as one of the parameters that is sent unhashed.

params.name: event_name
params.description: It is the standard or custom event name, and it has to match the browser event for deduplication to work.
params.fix_hint: Set `event_name` to the standard event, such as `Purchase`, or to your custom event name.

params.name: event_time
params.description: Meta documents it as a Unix timestamp in seconds, and it can be up to 7 days before the event is sent. A 13-digit value is milliseconds and lands far in the future.
params.fix_hint: Send seconds, not milliseconds: divide a JavaScript `Date.now()` by 1000 and floor it.

params.name: action_source
params.description: It tells Meta where the conversion happened, and Meta accepts a fixed set of values.
params.fix_hint: Use one of the documented values; website conversions are `website`.

params.name: user_data
params.description: Customer information is required on every server event, and it is what Meta matches the conversion to a person with.
params.fix_hint: Add a `user_data` object with at least one normalized, hashed identifier.

params.name: event_id
params.description: Meta recommends it for deduplication: the browser pixel and the server event have to carry the same `event_id` and `event_name` to be counted once.
params.fix_hint: Generate one id per conversion and send the same value from the pixel and the Conversions API.

params.name: event_source_url
params.description: It is the page URL where the conversion happened, and Meta requires it for website events.
params.fix_hint: Send the full URL of the page, including the scheme.

params.name: opt_out
params.description: When true, the event is used for attribution only and not for ads delivery optimization.

params.name: data_processing_options[]
params.description: Meta accepts `LDU` for Limited Data Use, or an empty array.
params.fix_hint: Send `["LDU"]` to enable Limited Data Use, or `[]` to leave it off.

params.name: data_processing_options_country
params.description: It is 1 for the United States, or 0 to let Meta geolocate.

params.name: data_processing_options_state
params.description: It is 1000 for California, or 0 to let Meta geolocate.

params.name: custom_data.value
params.description: Meta requires it for purchase events and for any event that uses value optimization.
params.fix_hint: Send the monetary value as a number, without a currency symbol.

params.name: custom_data.currency
params.description: Meta requires a valid ISO 4217 three-digit currency code.
params.fix_hint: Use the three-letter code, such as `USD`.

params.name: custom_data.content_ids[]
params.description: It is a product ID associated with the event, such as a SKU on AddToCart.
params.fix_hint: Send catalog IDs in `custom_data.content_ids`, or drop empty entries.

params.name: custom_data.content_type
params.description: It says whether `content_ids` and `contents` are products or product groups. Meta documents `product` or `product_group`.
params.fix_hint: Set `custom_data.content_type` to `product` or `product_group`.

params.name: custom_data.contents[].id
params.description: It is the product ID on a contents row. Meta documents `id`, `quantity`, `item_price`, and `delivery_category` on that object.
params.fix_hint: Set `custom_data.contents[].id` to the catalog item ID, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: custom_data.contents[].quantity
params.description: It is how many of that product the event covers.
params.fix_hint: Send a whole number in `custom_data.contents[].quantity`, such as `1`.

params.name: custom_data.contents[].item_price
params.description: It is the price of that product. Put the order total in `custom_data.value`.
params.fix_hint: Send `custom_data.contents[].item_price` as a number, such as `129.99`, without a currency symbol.

params.name: custom_data.contents[].delivery_category
params.description: It is the delivery type on a contents row. Meta documents `in_store`, `curbside`, and `home_delivery`.
params.fix_hint: Set the contents `delivery_category` to `in_store`, `curbside`, or `home_delivery`.

params.name: custom_data.delivery_category
params.description: It is the delivery type for a purchase event. Meta documents `in_store`, `curbside`, and `home_delivery`.
params.fix_hint: Set `custom_data.delivery_category` to `in_store`, `curbside`, or `home_delivery`.

params.name: custom_data.num_items
params.description: It is the number of items in checkout. Meta documents it for InitiateCheckout events.
params.fix_hint: Send a whole number in `custom_data.num_items`, such as `2`.

params.name: custom_data.order_id
params.description: It is the order ID for this transaction, as a string.
params.fix_hint: Send `custom_data.order_id`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: custom_data.search_string
params.description: It is the query the user searched for. Meta documents it for Search events.
params.fix_hint: Send the query in `custom_data.search_string`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: custom_data.predicted_ltv
params.description: It is the predicted lifetime value of a conversion event.
params.fix_hint: Send `custom_data.predicted_ltv` as a number, such as `250.00`.

params.name: referrer_url
params.description: It is the referrer URL for the event.
params.fix_hint: Send an absolute URL in `referrer_url`, including the scheme.

params.name: user_data.em
params.description: Email must be trimmed, lowercased, and SHA-256 hashed before it is sent.
params.fix_hint: Normalize the address, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

params.name: user_data.em[]
params.description: Every email in the list must be normalized and SHA-256 hashed.
params.fix_hint: Normalize each address, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digests.

params.name: user_data.ph
params.description: Phone numbers must have symbols and letters removed, carry the country code, and be SHA-256 hashed.
params.fix_hint: Normalize the number to digits with the country code, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

params.name: user_data.ph[]
params.description: Every phone number in the list must be normalized and SHA-256 hashed.
params.fix_hint: Normalize each number to digits with the country code and hash it with SHA-256.

params.name: user_data.fn
params.description: First name must be lowercased and SHA-256 hashed.

params.name: user_data.ln
params.description: Last name must be lowercased and SHA-256 hashed.

params.name: user_data.ge
params.description: Gender is sent as a lowercase initial and SHA-256 hashed.

params.name: user_data.db
params.description: Date of birth is normalized to YYYYMMDD and SHA-256 hashed.

params.name: user_data.ct
params.description: City is lowercased with punctuation and spaces removed, then SHA-256 hashed.

params.name: user_data.st
params.description: State is the lowercase two-character code, SHA-256 hashed.

params.name: user_data.zp
params.description: Zip is lowercased without spaces or dashes, then SHA-256 hashed.

params.name: user_data.country
params.description: Country is the lowercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, SHA-256 hashed.
params.fix_hint: Hash the two-letter code rather than sending it in the clear.

params.name: user_data.external_id
params.description: Meta recommends hashing the advertiser's own identifier with SHA-256.

params.name: user_data.client_ip_address
params.description: It is sent unhashed, and it must be the real IPv4 or IPv6 address of the browser.
params.fix_hint: Send the client address as-is; do not hash it and do not send your server's address.

params.name: user_data.client_user_agent
params.description: It is sent unhashed, and it must be the browser's user agent rather than your HTTP client's.
params.fix_hint: Forward the browser `User-Agent` header from the original request.

params.name: user_data.fbc
params.description: Meta documents the click id cookie as `fb.${subdomain_index}.${creation_time}.${fbclid}`.
params.fix_hint: Send the `_fbc` cookie verbatim, or rebuild it in the documented format.

params.name: user_data.fbp
params.description: Meta documents the browser id cookie as `fb.${subdomain_index}.${creation_time}.${random_number}`.
params.fix_hint: Send the `_fbp` cookie verbatim.

params.name: user_data.lead_id
params.description: It is the numeric id Meta generated for a Lead Ads lead.
Each event is a JSON object, rather than a scalar or list.
